comments.body: The pedlar in Alexandria sells limited numbers.

wiki:
Fire attack

Sold at Pedlar for 2,923 ducats in the following cities/regions:

Alexandria (East Mediterranean)
Luanda (West Africa)
Cape Town (South Africa)
Santo Domingo (Caribbean/Central America)
Havana (Caribbean/Central America)
Tenochtitlan (Caribbean/Central America)

Quantities vary and will automatically restock if reduced to 0 every 5 real-life minutes.


Extra Note:
Base item for Hanging Lantern ship deco; see its page for details.
